name: launcher
description: Launcher band: one compact row of answer-mode buttons (SHORT, STUDY, DEEP, TECH ...), EN/FR/AR reply buttons, shortcuts to your other mods when installed, and a Glossary pane built from this chat's STUDY terms. Zero tokens by itself.

sticky.title: Sticky mode
sticky.description: Off by default. When on, a mode or language you pick is added to every prompt you send until you clear it (about 3 tokens per prompt)

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr or ar (right to left)
